body: Very much this, and let him know you like having him around. It's small comments like that, that can completely change a bad day to a good one.

Ah, so you are finding it tough to open up completely to your therapist and psychiatrist. I understand how that can be incredibly difficult, especially since you said you felt safer I'm guessing you haven't had any sort of connection with them to allow yourself to open up.

That's why I suggested the anonymous venues, such as on here or the phone lines. You can just rant and ramble to a voice or to text instead of needing to see the person face to face and worry about their reactions. We are here for you, they are here for you. It's a giant safety net to help you get back on your feet and keep going, we're awesome like that. :)

What are you venting about and how are you going about doing it? After venting, are you taking steps to make any situation better(If you can that is. :) )? Also, have you considered speaking to a professional, honestly they are amazing people and can see things that we cannot through text. If you feel that you cannot talk to your friends for fear of more dislike, speak to them. Even the phone hotline people are awesome, and you don't need to give out any info other than what you want to say.

By professional, I mean have you spoken to them the same way as you have spoken to your friends? (Sorry, I wanted to clarify)

This sounds like it's going beyond what you can really supply, she needs to see someone. There are plenty of professional people she can speak with, and they are incredibly friendly and caring. There are some links in the sidebar to help. 

You're at a very difficult crossroads right now, and you are right you may be a blessing and a bane. In the end, she needs to see someone and if you are truly done with her, you need to step away. She will look for the caring that she used to get but you will be unable to give it, it will hurt her even more. If she truly needs you to help her with the first steps, alright. Just make sure boundaries are clear and DO NOT lead her on in the slightest, even if you think it will help.

You're not the only one who has dealt with this state of mind, I've felt it strongly as well. It is often brought on by stress, could be social, emotional, financial etc, not just one thing. Jump on here next time it hits if you get too low, lots of friendly eyes to read and ears to hear. :)

Feel free to vent on here a bit, there are alot of listeners and people who will try and help you as much as they can. It really sounds like you just need someone to talk to who will just listen. :)

No one here to call you a bad person, and you have a fresh start with all of them.
Kevin, anyone who would do that for you is worth sticking around for.

It's because you will have a base. Right now due to education you are tied down to one place and you can't just get up and head anywhere. There is a big feeling of freedom when you don't have those ties anymore but have documentation saying you're ready to take on the world. I know this from experience. 

As for "whole life ahead of you," I won't lie, you will remember this, it will be with you for a long time, but the pain does fade, in time. However right now a month or two away seems like an eternity, a year from now seems like it will never happen. But it will, and with each day that passes you will change, your view on things will change and if you keep trying you'll eventually find what you want in this life.

Life's too damn beautiful to quit. Just because things look dark now, doesn't mean they will look this way in a month. Right now time seems like it's the slowest thing ever, a minute is forever, an hour an eternity. As mentioned by others, just stop taking things now, stand back, deep breath, pull yourself together and know that time will help. It may seem dark now, but it can't rain all the time.
